content.text: Game Notice: Cash4Life® is retiring. Sales of this game will end Saturday, February 21, 2026. That means, starting February 12, 2026, you will only be able to purchase Cash4Life® tickets up to 10 draws in advance. Make sure to get your tickets early before the step-down starts! (Remember, you can purchase tickets at a Lottery retailer or online.) UPCOMING MAINTENANCE The website will undergo maintenance beginning Sunday, March 1st, at 10pm through Monday, March 2nd, 2026. Due to this maintenance, the Millionaire For LifeTM drawing may experience a delay. We apologize for any inconvenience.
